decisions.reason: Linking a homepage button to the Pricing page does not change the pricing diagram, service selection, or transparency requirements on that page.
The homepage button destination does not change the one-time pricing model or visibility of monthly and annual pricing tabs.
The mobile pricing-table request is a separate clause in the source message; changing homepage button destinations does not alter the table interaction requirement.
Revising homepage button links does not affect the hero image emphasis, overlay color, opacity, or visual effect.
The mobile hover-animation request is independent of the homepage button-destination change.
A homepage button linking to the Services page does not modify the requirement for representative service imagery.
Linking to the Gallery page does not change its category tabs or optional other-photography area.
The homepage Pricing button destination does not alter package count, square-footage ranges, or displayed package prices.
The homepage page-link decision neither resumes nor changes the deferred instant quote calculator.
Providing a homepage link to the Gallery page does not change the gallery's interactive scrolling behavior.
Homepage navigation destinations do not alter the site's image-focused presentation style.
Changing homepage button destinations does not modify responsiveness across desktop, tablet, or mobile layouts.
